constants.name: xl24HourClock
constants.description: True if you are using 24-hour time; False if you are using 12-hour time.

constants.name: xl4DigitYears
constants.description: True if you are using four-digit years; False if you are using two-digit years.

constants.name: xlAlternateArraySeparator
constants.description: Alternate array item separator to be used if the current array separator is the same as the decimal separator.

constants.name: xlColumnSeparator
constants.description: Character used to separate columns in array literals.

constants.name: xlCountrySetting
constants.description: Current country/region setting in the Windows Control Panel.

constants.name: xlCurrencyBefore
constants.description: True if the currency symbol precedes the currency values; False if it follows them.

constants.name: xlCurrencyDigits
constants.description: Number of decimal digits to be used in currency formats.

constants.name: xlCurrencyLeadingZeros
constants.description: True if leading zeros are displayed for zero currency values.

constants.name: xlCurrencyMinusSign
constants.description: True if you are using a minus sign for negative numbers; False if you are using parentheses.

constants.name: xlCurrencyNegative
constants.description: Currency format for negative currency values: 0 = (symbolx) or (xsymbol), 1 = -symbolx or -xsymbol, 2 = symbol-x or x-symbol, or 3 = symbolx- or xsymbol-, where symbol is the currency symbol of the country or region. Note that the position of the currency symbol is determined by xlCurrencyBefore.

constants.name: xlCurrencySpaceBefore
constants.description: True if a space is added before the currency symbol.

constants.name: xlCurrencyTrailingZeros
constants.description: True if trailing zeros are displayed for zero currency values.

constants.name: xlDateOrder
constants.description: Order of date elements: 0 = month-day-year, 1 = day-month-year, 2 = year-month-day

constants.name: xlDayLeadingZero
constants.description: True if a leading zero is displayed in days.

constants.name: xlGeneralFormatName
constants.description: Name of the General number format.

constants.name: xlLeftBrace
constants.description: Character used instead of the left brace ({) in array literals.

constants.name: xlLeftBracket
constants.description: Character used instead of the left bracket ([) in R1C1-style relative references.

constants.name: xlMDY
constants.description: True if the date order is month-day-year for dates displayed in the long form; False if the date order is day-month-year.

constants.name: xlMetric
constants.description: True if you are using the metric system; False if you are using the English measurement system.

constants.name: xlMonthLeadingZero
constants.description: True if a leading zero is displayed in months (when months are displayed as numbers).

constants.name: xlMonthNameChars
constants.description: Always returns three characters for backward compatibility. Abbreviated month names are read from Microsoft Windows and can be any length.

constants.name: xlNoncurrencyDigits

constants.name: xlNonEnglishFunctions
constants.description: True if you are not displaying functions in English.

constants.name: xlRightBrace
constants.description: Character used instead of the right brace (}) in array literals.

constants.name: xlRightBracket
constants.description: Character used instead of the right bracket (]) in R1C1-style references.

constants.name: xlRowSeparator
constants.description: Character used to separate rows in array literals.

constants.name: xlTimeLeadingZero
constants.description: True if a leading zero is displayed in times.

constants.name: xlWeekdayNameChars
constants.description: Always returns three characters for backward compatibility. Abbreviated weekday names are read from Microsoft Windows and can be any length.

enumerations.name: XlApplyNamesOrder

constants.name: xlArabicNone
constants.description: The spelling checker ignores spelling rules regarding either Arabic words ending with the letter yaa or Arabic words beginning with an alef hamza.

constants.name: xlArabicStrictAlefHamza

constants.name: xlArabicStrictFinalYaa
constants.description: The spelling checker uses spelling rules regarding Arabic words ending with the letter yaa.

constants.name: xlArabicBothStrict
constants.description: The spelling checker uses spelling rules regarding both Arabic words ending with the letter yaa and Arabic words beginning with an alef hamza.

enumerations.name: XlArrowHeadLength
enumerations.description: Specifies the length of the arrowhead at the end of a line.

enumerations.description: Specifies the type of arrowhead to apply at the end of a line.

constants.name: xlArrowHeadStyleClosed

constants.name: xlArrowHeadStyleDoubleOpen

enumerations.name: XlArrowHeadWidth

enumerations.name: XlAutoFillType
enumerations.description: Specifies how the target range is to be filled, based on the contents of the source range.

constants.name: xlFillCopy
constants.description: Copy the values and formats from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlFillDays
constants.description: Extend the names of the days of the week in the source range into the target range. Formats are copied from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlFillDefault
constants.description: Excel determines the values and formats used to fill the target range.

constants.name: xlFillFormats
constants.description: Copy only the formats from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlFillMonths
constants.description: Extend the names of the months in the source range into the target range. Formats are copied from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlFillSeries
constants.description: Extend the values in the source range into the target range as a series (for example, '1, 2' is extended as '3, 4, 5'). Formats are copied from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlFillValues
constants.description: Copy only the values from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlFillWeekdays
constants.description: Extend the names of the days of the workweek in the source range into the target range. Formats are copied from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlFillYears
constants.description: Extend the years in the source range into the target range. Formats are copied from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlGrowthTrend
constants.description: Extend the numeric values from the source range into the target range, assuming that the relationships between the numbers in the source range are multiplicative (for example, '1, 2,' is extended as '4, 8, 16', assuming that each number is a result of multiplying the previous number by some value). Formats are copied from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlLinearTrend
constants.description: Extend the numeric values from the source range into the target range, assuming that the relationships between the numbers is additive (for example, '1, 2,' is extended as '3, 4, 5', assuming that each number is a result of adding some value to the previous number). Formats are copied from the source range to the target range, repeating if necessary.

constants.name: xlFlashFill
constants.description: Extend the values from the source range into the target range based on the detected pattern of previous user actions, repeating if necessary.
